title: Docs attribution events
description: data/docs_events.json: which MCP guides send consent-gated GA4 events, how a code card or link maps to a client, and the event names and parameters. layouts/_partials/docs-attribution.html emits it as JSON for assets/js/docs-attribution.js; the payload shapes live in schemas/defs/docs-event.schema.json. Hosts are bare host names, never URLs, so no new origin appears in the build (see docs/docs-attribution.md).

pages.description: Path prefixes (the site's pretty URLs, with leading and trailing slash) where events run. Every other analytics page only captures first-touch attribution.

consent_key.description: The localStorage key assets/js/consent.js writes; events run only while it is granted.

consent_event.description: The document event consent.js dispatches when the reader grants consent.

storage_key.description: The sessionStorage key for the session's first-touch attribution, written only after consent.

default_client.description: The client value when no client heading, hash or mcp_client front matter applies.

clients.description: Heading id (render-heading.html, from the heading text) to client name. The nearest enclosing h2 or h3 decides a code card's or link's client.

snippet_kinds.description: A code card's data-lang (code-card.html) to snippet_kind; any other language is other.

outbound.description: Link rules in order; the first match names the link_kind. A rule matches a host in hosts (exact) or, with site true, the page's own host; paths are regexes over the URL path, any path when absent.

internal_hosts.description: Referrer hosts that are this site; with the page's own host they never count as first_referrer_host.

utm_params.description: Landing-URL parameters copied into first_source, first_medium, first_campaign, first_content and first_term, in that order.

attribution_params.description: Sent on every event, captured once per session after consent on whichever analytics page comes first. landing_guide is the first tracked guide seen in the session, landing_page the first page path.

events.description: GA4 event names (snake_case) and their own parameters; attribution_params are added to each. Payload schemas: schemas/defs/docs-event.schema.json.
